created_prompt: My friend Julie is a great cook with a huge online following for her videos showcasing her quick, healthy recipes. She's asked for my help in devising a strategy to increase her online audience beyond her current 1.2 million followers. She's also thinking about putting together a cookbook. To help me help her, I'd like you to put together the following: (1) a structured three-year plan to foster the online growth; and (2) a thorough pros & cons list of self-publishing vs. going through a traditional publisher for her cookbooks. When generating these, please be mindful that Julie is limited to working on this project no more than 4 days per week, and doesn't have a lot free cash to put into the project right now (so plan using a limited budget).
